response: Ward G/N (Dadar West, Mahim, Dharavi) has billed Rs 6755738 of its Rs 8400000 monsoon road budget, or 80.4 percent, across 139 repair jobs. Of these, 29.5 percent were reopened within 30 days and 36.7 percent met the repair deadline. Some of this is expected: the city had 18 days of heavy or worse rain this season, and G/N is a low lying ward (index 0.8) where flooding is common. Still, Rs 986130 was billed on DLP roads. DLP means the road is still under the original contractor's warranty, so repairs should cost the city nothing. These bills need review. Also, 3 jobs were priced more than 30 percent above the rate card and should be checked. The top contractor by spend is Arabian Sea Engineering (synthetic). Example work orders are WO25-00343 and WO25-01460. Ward officers can ask whether the DLP contractors were asked to fix those roads first.
